title: ParsHate: A Benchmark Dataset for Hate and Target Detection in Persian
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark dataset (ParsHate) for hate speech detection that explicitly includes 'Religion' (with fine-grained annotations for 'Islam' versus other religions) as a specific target category. It benchmarks models on their ability to detect hate speech directed at religious groups and culturally/historically religious references, thereby assessing LLM behavior and representation concerning religious topics.
